programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: The competition concludes as the two finalists battle it out for the position of head chef at Gordon Ramsay Steak at the Paris Las Vegas.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Twenty aspiring restaurateurs hope to impress Ramsay by present their signature dishes to him. After the opening night dinner service, the least successful contestants face elimination.

programme.title: Hell's Kitchen USA
programme.desc: Teamwork plays an important role during a relay race in which duos must accomplish basic culinary tasks; while challenge winners go to San Francisco, the losing team picks carrots at a farm; both teams disappoint during dinner service.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 204
programme.desc: En gammel mann som har en uforklarlig stank, konsulterer doktor Ellingham; og den lokale radioverten, Caroline, har et alvorlig drikkeproblem.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 205
programme.desc: Martin undersøker Helen Pratt, men hun kollapser og dør. Mannen hennes, Phil, er sint på legen og gir ham skylden for konas død.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 206
programme.desc: Martins vanskelige foreldre kommer for å bo hos ham. Han har ikke sett dem på syv år, og er forvirret over hvorfor de plutselig skulle dukke opp nå.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 207
programme.desc: Mark Mylow planlegger å tilbringe sitt utdrikningslag i skogen med Al Large, men han blir bitt av en huggorm.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 208
programme.desc: Et medlem av Frelsesarmeen kommer til Portwenn for å prøve å finne en savnet kvinne. Danny ber sin motvillige kjæreste Louisa om flytte inn hos ham.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 301
programme.desc: Martin mistenker at Louisa kan ha anemi. Tante Joan blir tvunget til å motta behandling fra Martin etter at hun nesten kjørte på noen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 302
programme.desc: Bert Large forlater rørleggerfirmaet sitt til fordel for å drive en restaurant. Etter restaurantens åpning forekommer det flere tilfeller av matforgiftning.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 303
programme.desc: Et par og sønnen deres flytter inn ved siden av Louisa og skaper problemer for henne, Martin og lokalbefolkningen. Beboere begynner også å oppdage noe uvanlig med PC Penhale.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 304
programme.desc: Fru Wilson, den hypokondriske eieren av Wilson-hotellet, vier all sin oppmerksomhet til Martin, noe som fører til at Louisa blir sjalu.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 305
programme.desc: Paulines spilleavhengighet kommer endelig fram i lyset.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 306
programme.desc: En mystisk luftveisinfeksjon bryter ut i landsbyen.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 307
programme.desc: På bryllupsdagen får brudepiken til Louisa konfetti i øyet; den lokale blomsterhandleren blir arrestert og blir tvunget til å stenge butikken sin.

programme.title: Doc Martin: Episode 401
programme.desc: Dr. Martin Ellingham og Louisa har tatt den hjerteskjærende avgjørelsen om å avlyse bryllupet deres.

programme.title: Meet Me Under the Mistletoe
programme.desc: To rivaliserende eiendomsmeglere blir tvunget til å samarbeide for å selge et spesielt hus, eid av en anerkjent botaniker og mistelteindyrker, før jul.

programme.title: The Christmas Spirit
programme.desc: En ulykke fører til at Charlotte havner i koma, men ånden hennes er våken. I forkant av en avstemning om et eiendomsprosjekt må hun få byen og utbyggeren til å ombestemme seg uten at noen kan se eller høre henne.

programme.title: Christmas on Candy Cane Lane
programme.desc: Ivy balanserer ferieforpliktelser, datteren og motstridende følelser til eksmannen, alt samtidig med at en mystisk skøyer skaper rabalder i Candy Cane Lane.

programme.title: A Christmas Blessing
programme.desc: Mandy selger sin avdøde tantes matsentral, Angel's Fare, til den lokale bedriftseieren Adam, men en frivillig som jobber der ønsker å arrangere en siste julemiddag.

programme.title: Christmas Unfiltered
programme.desc: På julaften ønsker Becky at familien hennes virkelig skal høre henne. Alle tankene og frustrasjonene hennes renner ut når hun uforvarende begynner å fortelle alle hva hun egentlig tenker.

programme.title: Christmas Party Crashers
programme.desc: Når to bedragere møtes etter å ha krasjet den samme millionærens julefest, blir de enige om å jobbe sammen, uten å vite at de vil finne noe som er viktigere enn penger eller berømmelse: ekte kjærlighet.

programme.title: Back to Christmas
programme.desc: En kvinne reiser ett år tilbake i tid til julen før hennes brutte forlovelse og prøver å reparere det som gikk galt. Hun oppdager at dette er en større utfordrende oppgave enn hun trodde.

programme.title: Hotel for the Holidays
programme.desc: Samtidig som hotelldirektøren Georgia navigerer i romantiske forviklinger med kokken og en kjekk prins, får vi et innblikk i livet til andre gjester og ansatte.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Aaron And Kyle's Bust Up
programme.desc: Ios. Chloes forsøk på å få Scotts oppmerksomhet går helt skeivt. En tur til stranden avslører en fin overraskelse for Nathan. Holly og Kyles situasjon tilspisser seg og får alvorlige konsekvenser for de to.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Home Truths For Holly
programme.desc: Mykonos. Etter hans dramatiske exit, venner gjengen seg til livet etter Kyle. Chloes plan om å gjøre Scott sjalu slår tilbake, og Charlotte gir Holly litt beinhard kjærlighet som ikke glir ned så lett.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Happy Gay Day!
programme.desc: Zante. Chloe og Holly stikker før Chloe konfronterer Scott og plumper ut med hva hun egentlig føler. I mens får Marnie en uventet telefon, og Nathan har store nyheter til familien.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The Proposal
programme.desc: Geordie-gjengens store, greske eventyr slutter på dramatisk vis. Etter at Cloe slapp K-bomben, vil Scott prate. En i familien får et overraskende besøk og Marnie har noen massive nyheter å komme med.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: New Girl In Town
programme.desc: Geordie-gjengen er tilbake og skaper hollabaloy! Chloe blir en slem heks for å få ha seg med Scott. Holly har en diger hemmelighet, men kan hun fortelle den? Og en ny deltager sjokkerer og får liv i gutta, men gjør Chloe svært stressa.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Hello Single Charlotte!
programme.desc: Charlotte kommer med store nyheter for Gaz . Kan Holly avsløre hemmeligheten sin nå? Aaron og Scotts dater med den nye jenta Chantelle ender dårlig.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Holly's Tears
programme.desc: Charlotte pusser snoppdetektivene på Gaz, og Scott forbløffer alle da han vil være kjæreste med den nye jenta Chantelle. Holly krangler med Charlotte da hun ser henne kysse Chloe.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Girls Just Want To Have Fun
programme.sub-title: Girls Just Want To Have Fun
programme.desc: Mens Holly er borte tar Chloe og Charlotte vennskapet sitt til neste nivå. Chantelles plan for å teste Scott går helt feil og Chloe er rask til å utnytte det. Charlotte forsøker å ordne opp i ting med Holly.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: You're The Victim!
programme.desc: Sjefen Anna spanderer en tur til Hull på Geordiene. Gaz og Charlotte tilbringer natten sammen, og Chloe forteller endelig Chantelle sannheten om hva hun ga Scott. I tillegg kommer det enda en overraskelse når Marnie vender tilbake.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The 'L' Bomb
programme.desc: Festaften! En ny gutt ankommer og Chloe gleder seg. Charlotte sjekker opp en fyr rett foran Gaz. Marnie blir gal når en av Aarons venninner dukker opp. Den nye gutten fyrer opp krangelen mellom Scott og Chantelle.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Breaking Girl Code
programme.desc: Nest siste episode. Marnie kliner med den nye gutten Marty for å gi Aaron en lærepenge. Charlotte støtter Chloe når det tar helt av mellom jentene. Gary og Charlotte ender opp i sengehalmen og ryster hele Geordie-huset.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: More Than Friends
programme.desc: Det er siste episode og Geordie-gjengen skuffer ikke. Gary kommer tilbake og slipper en bombe. Den nye typen Marty får ikke stå med Chloe. Scott og Chantelle blir 'venner'. Holly må ta et viktig valg og avslutningen kommer som et sjokk!

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Gaz's Shock Revelation
programme.desc: Geordies er tilbake! Big Boss Anna har sendt gjengen til Magaluf. Marnie ønsker mer av Aaron, det svirrer et stygt rykte om Holly, og Marty åpner seg for Chloe. Ting ser bra ut helt til Chloe blir sjalu og det hele sparkes i gang.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: The G-Bomb
programme.desc: Ibiza. På båtfesten er single Gaz tilbake og klarer å sjekke opp Chantelle. Men hvordan vil Holly reagere når hun får vite det? Chloe klekker ut en plan for å få Marty, men han flykter ut av et vindu.

programme.title: Geordie Shore: Broken Relationships
programme.desc: Maga. Big Boss Anna er rasende når gjengen endelig returnerer fra Ibiza. Marnies plan om å få Aarons oppmerksomhet slår feil og parforholdet er i krise når Nathan blir involvert. Gaz og Holly prøver å snake ut om Chantelle-kysset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Free Vinny
programme.desc: Mike kommer tilbake, bare for å finne ut at Danny har truet med å finne nye medboere! Jentene leier strippere til Pauly og Mikes ville bursdagsfest, og deltakerne reiser til Staten Island for å kidnappe Vinny. Men vil han bli med dem?

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Nothing But Nice
programme.desc: Vinny kommer tilbake, og alle feirer. Mike prøver å være hyggelig, men ender opp med å irritere guttene. Snooki sliter med en ubehagelig situasjon.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Follow Game
programme.desc: The Situation samler opplysninger for å ødelegge for en av de andre, og for en gangs skyld er det ikke Snooki. JWoww får panikk fordi Roger har forsvunnet og ikke ringer henne tilbake.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Love at the Jersey Shore
programme.desc: Alle deltakerne er konsentrert om sine nåværende kjærester, men det er aldri fred og ro i huset. En av deltakerne skaper drama for The Meatballs, mens Jennis utfordrende klær skaper problemer for Roger.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Sharp Objects
programme.desc: Deltakerne prøver å unngå et haiangrep på fisketur. Jenni konfronterer Paulys stalker. Snooki ser seg ut Vinny da hun blir avvist av kjæresten.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: The Truth Will Set You Free
programme.sub-title: The Truth Will Set You Free
programme.desc: Mike klarer ikke å vente lenger med å avsløre 'sannheten' for Snookis kjæreste. Pauly, Vinny og Deena synes det er vanskelig å være de single i huset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: One Meatball Stands Alone
programme.desc: Da Mike forteller Jionni om ham og Snooki, blir det bråk. Deena må takle sannheten om Joey. Noen fra huset drar på camping, mens Vinny og Pauly drar den største spøken i hele Shore-historien!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 502
programme.desc: Her møtes Mike, Snooki, Pauly og Deena og snakker om å komme tilbake til Seaside Heights, og om Vinnys hjemlengsel. Og når gjengen gjennomgår dramatikken mellom Mike og Snooki, heiter det seg til en smule.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 504
programme.desc: Vi møter Mike, Vinny og Deena som snakker om da Vinny kom tilbake til strandhuset, om Mikes forhold til Paula og Paulys forhold til...vel, alle andre. Og vi får en snikkikk på neste episode!

programme.title: Jersey Shore: After Hours 507
programme.desc: Det er damenes aften og Jenni, Sammi, Snooki og Deena skravler om Jennis kjærlighetstrøbbel med Roger, om kjøttbollegreier og Guidette-problemer. Og vi får en snikkikk på hva vi har i vente.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Gym, Tan, Look Back
programme.desc: Jerseygjengen tar et tilbakeblikk på sin reise sammen de siste tre årene. Amerikas yndlingssamboere forteller i intervjuer sine unike historier om uforglemmelige øyeblikk. Og en sniktitt på sesong 6 er med.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Once More Unto the Beach
programme.desc: Alle kommer til strandhuset en siste gang. The Situation forteller ærlig om rehabiliteringen og Snooki må møte den utfordringen det er å være gravid i et hus skapt for festing og moro.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: No Shame, Good Integrity
programme.desc: Romkameratene installerer seg i strandhuset og Deena må takle å være adskilt fra kjæresten sin. Nicole kommer med en kunngjøring som sjokkerer hele huset.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Toxic Shots Syndrome
programme.desc: Snooki flytter ut av strandhuset for seg selv og Dina sliter uten kjøttbollen sin. Mike må takle baksiden av rehabiliteringen etter å ha fått behandling av en lege.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Blues, Balls, & Brawls
programme.desc: Jenny planlegger en overraskelsesfest på Rogers bursdag som faller litt i fisk. Deena prøver ut Danny som kjøttbolle. Vennegjengen befinner seg plutselig midt i et digert basketak på klubben og en av dem meies ned i håndgemengen.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Merp Walk
programme.desc: Jenny får vite omfanget av skaden sin. Mike vurderer å gå et skritt videre i forholdet til Paula. Når Deena holder kjøttbolle-auditioner, ender det med at hun selv triller ut av panna og rett ned i bålet.

programme.title: Jersey Shore: Let's Make it Official
programme.desc: Jenni lurer på hvordan det går mellom henne og Roger og forstår at de kanskje er verre ute og kjøre enn hun trodde. Mike vil ta forholdet med Paula et skritt videre...til han får virkeligheten i fanget.

programme.title: Matlock: Power Brokers (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock runs into a series of high-level roadblocks when he goes to Washington to defend a popular columnist accused of murdering her source.

programme.title: Matlock: Power Brokers (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock finds himself in a legal dilemma: his client stuns the courtroom with a confession, and then, saying that government agents had persuaded her to do so, tries to recant it.

programme.title: Matlock: Network
programme.desc: Matlock defends Paul J. Bartel, a top TV producer accused of murdering the programming chief at the top-rated network, and finds the case has more twists than most Hollywood scripts.

programme.title: Matlock: Best Friend
programme.desc: When a renowned author is murdered, Matlock defends the accused – the subject of a biography the victim was writing – only to encounter a disturbing revelation about his client midway through the trial.

programme.title: Matlock: Christmas Show
programme.desc: Matlock serves double duty: defending Brian Emerson, who’s charged with killing his ex-wife, and babysitting Emerson’s 6-year-old daughter.

programme.title: Matlock: The Body
programme.desc: Ben Matlock learns there is more to an exclusive health spa than workouts when his client, Donna Stewart, is accused of murdering a sexy, young exercise instructor who had been having an affair with her husband.

programme.title: Matlock: The Reunion
programme.desc: A law school class reunion proves deadly for one of Matlock’s former classmates, and Ben takes on the defense of another old friend, George Dutton, the partner of the victim.

programme.title: Matlock: The Umpire
programme.desc: Matlock attempts to defend Charlie Bonham, a softball coach who is accused of killing the umpire – who was also his boss – during the league’s playoff game.

programme.title: Matlock: Investigation (Part 1)
programme.desc: Matlock is surprised to learn that his long-time client, respected businessman Craig Gentry, is the son of mob boss Sam Gerard. The ace attorney must defend Craig of the murder of a senator who was investigating organized crime.

programme.title: Matlock: Investigation (Part 2)
programme.desc: Matlock has his hands full defending his client, Craig Gentry, while also trying to prevent a full-scale mob war from breaking out between Craig’s father and two of his enemies.

programme.title: Matlock: The Hucksters

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 613
programme.desc: Når sønnen endelig blir frisk, føler Charlott seg ikke lenger som seg selv, og hun velger derfor å ta en brystforstørrelsesoperasjon. Men resultatet ble en stor skuffelse.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 407
programme.desc: Vi møter Maria, som etter en brystoperasjon fikk store abscesser og hull helt inn til implantatet.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 203
programme.desc: I dagens episode møter vi bl.a. Pia, som fikk stafylokokker etter en brystforstørrende operasjon og måtte gå i seks måneder med bare ett implantat.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 701
programme.desc: Etter en alvorlig ulykke, hvor Dan faller ned fra et tak og lander på ansiktet, opereres han to ganger for å rette opp nesen sin.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 510
programme.desc: Etter fødselen velger Camilla å operere brystene. Det viser seg imidlertid at kirurgen ved en feil har brukt tråder som ikke er selvoppløsende, og Camilla lever i dag med store sår.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 610
programme.desc: Sportsgale Jeanette ble inspirert for 12 år siden av en trend i treningsstudioet, hvor vennene hennes fikk forstørret brystene. I motsetning til venninnene liker hun ikke de nye, store puppene.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 506
programme.desc: I 2010 fikk Birthe satt inn saltvannsimplantater i stedet for de vanlige silikonimplantatene. 5 år senere våkner hun til et skremmende syn - det ene implantatet hennes er borte.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 605
programme.desc: Når Annika ble 30 år, fikk hun penger til en skjønnhetsoperasjon av mannen sin. Paret reiser sammen til Litauen, men allerede på operasjonsdagen oppdager Annika at den litauiske kirurgen ikke gjorde det de hadde avtalt.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 702
programme.desc: Jeanett bryster henger etter at hun har født to barn, og hun bestemmer seg for å ta et brystløft og implantater. Men operasjonen blir en skuffelse for Jeanett.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 801
programme.desc: For 25 år siden var Susanne involvert i en voldsom trafikkulykke som vansiret ansiktet hennes. Siden ulykken har hun vært gjennom mer enn ti operasjoner, men føler likevel at hun ser ut som et monster.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 611
programme.desc: Etter å ha ammet over en lenger periode får Pernille slappe bryster, og hun velger derfor å ta en brystforstørrelsesoperasjon. Men i dag er hun så lei seg over resultatet.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 804
programme.desc: Allerede i en alder av 15 år bestemmer Caroline seg for at hun vil bruke sparepengene sine på nye bryster så snart hun fyller 18. Men høyre bryst begynte å henge, og brystene hennes ble ulike.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 206
programme.desc: Louise brukte familiens penger på en brystoperasjon som ble en traumatisk opplevelse for henne. Camilla er flau over brystvortene sine, og Jeanette lever i frykt for at implantatene er giftige.

programme.title: Skjønnhetsfellen Danmark: Episode 508
programme.desc: Etter to svangerskap er Jeannette lei av strekkmerkene på magen. Lokalpolitiker Karina satt igjen med to bryster uten fylde, etter å ha ammet sine to barn.

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens han er fanget i en kamp mellom to Nietzschean-stolthetspunkter, fanger mannskapet en fiendtlig som hevder at stoltheten hans har et kart over slipstream.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusjonen av majestet
programme.desc: En feil sving etter å ha gått ut av en slipstream sender Andromeda inn i Prolon-systemet. De redder en fluktpute fra en viss katastrofe, men stoltheten vil ha den tilbake.

programme.title: Andromeda: Twilight of the Idols
programme.desc: Mannskapet søker en tapt koloni av Nietzscheans og oppdager et annet mannskap som i det skjulte har hjulpet dem.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dommens dag, Vredens dag
programme.desc: Mannskapet installerer en ny AI i et nytt Commonwealth-slagskip, og naturlig nok går ikke ting som de skal.

programme.desc: Tyr overbeviser Nietzscheans at han er reinkarnasjonen til Drago Museveni.

programme.desc: En melding fra en samler sender Dylan på et oppdrag for å redde et gissel og finne restene av Commonwealth-flåten.

programme.title: Andromeda: Biter av åtte
programme.desc: Citizen Eight prøver å fjerne Dylan fra kommandoen over Andromeda.

programme.title: Andromeda: Waking the Tyrant's Device
programme.desc: Mannskapet må stoppe en verdensbygger før han setter i gang en annen invasjon.

programme.title: Andromeda: Dobbelt eller ingenting
programme.desc: Dylan blir kidnappet av Nietzscheans og tvunget til å spille tankespill til underholdning for fangene hans.

programme.title: Andromeda: Harper/Slett
programme.desc: To Nietzschean-søsken er i en avstand over et våpen som kan eliminere høyere hjernefunksjoner.

programme.title: Andromeda: Snart den nærende virvelen
programme.desc: Tyr kommer tilbake, etter å ha sluttet seg til Collectors, og krever aldersruten fra sine tidligere besetningsmedlemmer.

programme.title: Andromeda: Verden snur seg rundt henne
programme.desc: En gisselsituasjon oppstår når mannskapet konfronterer Tyr.

programme.title: Andromeda: Kanal til skjebne
programme.desc: En feil sving i glidestrømmen fører Andromeda til et fengselsopprør.

programme.title: Andromeda: Machines of the Mind
programme.desc: Andromeda-mannskapet går opp for å finne ut hvem som drepte en gruppe forskere.

programme.desc: Andromeda-mannskapet går opp for å finne ut hvem som drepte en gruppe forskere.

programme.title: Forensic Files: The Stake-Out
programme.desc: Police are led on a wild goose chase when the wife of a prominent banker is kidnapped. An entomologist's unexpected discovery leads to a new suspect — and the realization that ordinary office equipment can leave extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Walking Terror
programme.desc: A neighbor watched as a man stabbed his wife, pushed her into the swimming pool and held her head under water. The husband, however, had no recollection of the crime. A jury would have to decide between evidence and the mysteries of the mind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Marked for Life
programme.desc: It would take 46 years, handwriting analysis and new fingerprint technology to solve the 1957 murders of two California police officers.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Plastic Puzzle
programme.desc: A man riding a bicycle was fatally injured in what police believed to be a hit-and-run accident. Tiny clues found at the scene created a picture of the vehicle which struck him and led police to its driver.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Up in Smoke
programme.desc: When an elderly couple died in a suspicious house fire, their son became the prime suspect. Investigators turned to forensic science to determine if the fire had been set deliberately, or if it was an unfortunate accident.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Soiled Plan
programme.desc: Police instituted an intense search when the mother of two young children went missing. Twenty years after her body was found, new technology recontextualized old evidence and pointed directly to the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Headquarters
programme.desc: When hunters reported finding a skull in a Texas canyon, police immediately began an investigation. With a forensic artist's reconstruction, police eventually learned the victim's identity. Now all they had to do was find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: One for the Road
programme.desc: A married couple decided to escape the cold of winter with a mini-vacation in Key West. The wife went missing and police searched every square inch of the island; they found nothing but a pair of sandals which might have belonged to her.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Army of Evidence
programme.desc: A mother of two young children was found dead in her bedroom. Her death was ruled a suicide — but when investigators learned she had almost died in a house fire three years earlier, they decided to take another look at the evidence.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shear Luck
programme.desc: In 1991, when the wife of a serviceman was brutally murdered in the Philippines, investigators had to reassemble a tiny computer disk that had been cut to pieces in order to find the killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tagging a Suspect
programme.desc: Bombings are difficult to solve because the perpetrator isn't usually at the scene and the evidence goes up in smoke. In this case, pieces of plastic the size of grains of sand hold the key to finding a murderer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cereal Killer
programme.desc: When a fire destroyed most of a home and a young boy went missing, police organized the largest search in the history of their small town. First the boy's backpack was discovered five miles from home, then his body was found 50 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Crash Course
programme.desc: A highway patrolman was dispatched to what he thought would be a routine traffic accident — until he looked in the car. He had seen hundreds of accidents, but none with as much blood as this.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg Up On Crime
programme.desc: The decomposed body of a young woman was discovered in a Bakersfield irrigation canal. If there was trace evidence, it had been washed away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Tight-Fitting Genes
programme.desc: A behavioral profile caused the Baton Rouge Police Department to search for the wrong man. The real perpetrator may have eluded arrest, had it not been for a molecular biologist who painted DNA picture of the suspect.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Valentine
programme.desc: An obstetrician returned home from the hospital and found his wife on the bathroom floor. She was covered with blood and not breathing. He tried unsuccessfully to revive her, staining his clothes with her blood in the process.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Picture This
programme.desc: A Modesto, California teenager goes missing. With no signs of struggle in her home, police suspect she has simply run away — until her naked, bruised body is discovered in a ditch 20 miles away.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Oily in the Morning
programme.desc: When police recovered the submerged car of a missing man, they expected to find his body — but it wasn't there. The investigation that followed would uncover an obsession turned deadly.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Gold Rush
programme.desc: Emergency dispatch received a call from a man who said his girlfriend shot and killed herself. The autopsy revealed that the gunshot wound was not self-inflicted, and the evidence on her body would give police a golden opportunity to catch her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Four on the Floor
programme.desc: When a Native American woman is brutally killed in the desert of New Mexico, her killers leave a crime scene rich in forensic evidence: tire tracks, shoe impressions and even the murder weapons.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Writer's Block
programme.desc: A brilliant young architect falls ill and dies just before she is to testify in a criminal trial. The autopsy reveals she'd been poisoned with arsenic. Investigators must determine who had a motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: When a dry cleaner employee is raped and murdered in her store, police turn to forensic science for the answers they need.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Unholy Alliance
programme.desc: When a young woman disappeared, police feared she was the latest victim in a string of similar crimes. A pair of bloody gloves, unique tire tracks and ordinary pine needles provided investigators with some extraordinary clues.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Cop Out
programme.desc: When a college student is found dead, evidence suggests that he knew his killer. With just three hairs and some microscopic cells, police unravel a web of lies and find the motive for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Summer Obsession
programme.desc: In an affluent suburb of Philadelphia, police were called to the scene of what appeared to be an accidental drowning. The investigation gradually focused on one suspect who had more than a million reasons to want the victim dead.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Elemental Clue
programme.desc: When two women from the same town were murdered in the same way, police feared a serial killer was on the loose. At first they thought the victims had nothing in common until they found tiny clues linking them to the same man.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Moss, Not Grass
programme.desc: A young woman was found dead on a golf course in the Bahamas. The grass on that course was so distinctive, it had evidentiary value. The evidence led police to two suspects, each of whom blamed the other.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scattered Clues
programme.desc: There's never a good reason for murder, but some killers are particularly brutalchoosing their prey at random or with no apparent motive and then cunningly covering their tracks. Even so, telltale clues remain.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Compulsion
programme.desc: Forensic psychologists delve into the minds of serial killers, explaining why, most often, they can be a friendly neighbor or the tenacious co-worker: the one who hides his or her dark side better than anyone else.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Toxic Death
programme.desc: Sometimes, the cause of death does not match the scene of the crime. When an untraceable poison is used to commit murder, homicide detectives turn to forensic toxicologists to follow a killer's tracks and expose a toxic death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Short Fuse
programme.desc: Explosives Investigations: The crime lab is the place where science meets murder. In New York State, Eleanor Fowler opened a small package, which was mailed to her home. When she lifted the lid, the box exploded, killing her instantly.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Drawing Conclusions
programme.desc: A teenager is abducted on a shopping trip. Two hikers disappear from the Appalachian Trail.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written in Blood
programme.desc: In North Carolina, the home of a prominent couple becomes an unlikely scene of terrible bloodshed. Across the country, a California woman vanishes, worrying her family and the investigators trying to find her.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Wasted Youth
programme.desc: When teenagers are driven to kill, their victims are but the first to fall. In three such cases, the families of the killers, as well as their communities, become the victims of violent crime.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Crimes Of Passion
programme.desc: When killers are driven by jealousy and desire, their desperation is evident in both the crime and their efforts to avoid detection. But forensic science can reveal even the slightest mistake to solve crimes of passion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Cases
programme.desc: These cases took a decade or more to solve. There's no statute of limitations on murder. As a case turns cold, the clues become scarce, investigators must rely on science to close cold cases.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Raw Greed
programme.desc: A friendly Midwest lodge becomes the scene of a gruesome double murder. Two men are dead and a safe filled with cash is missing.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Grave Secrets
programme.desc: Killers often attempt to deflect attention away from their crimes by hiding the remains of their victims. Bodies may lay hidden for years before they are discovered.

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Dire Deception (Laurence Maille Case)
programme.desc: On November 28, 2007, Laurence Maille disappeared. It was her partner, John Zablevski, who alerted the Vimy police in Pas-de-Calais. He explained that the young woman had left in the morning for a walk with their dog and never returned.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.sub-title: Stabed In Her Bed: The Maureen Jaquier Case
programme.desc: On February 27, 2015, in Toulouse, the parents of 19-year-old Maureen Jacquier discover their daughter stabbed several times in her bed.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.sub-title: Shot At Point-Blank: The Aurelie Barbot Affair
programme.desc: On December 20, 2012, in Val d'Izé (Ille-et-Vilaine), Aurélie Barbot, 29, was killed on her doorstep with a bullet to the head.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Honeymoon Killers (Van Beers Case)
programme.desc: Marc Van Beers, a 36-year old Brussels tax lawyer, dies in a road accident while on honeymoon. His wife Aurore is unharmed by the accident.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Mysterious Hanging On Houseboat (Aubry case)
programme.desc: Dominique Aubry, a rich widow of 58, is found hanged on her barge in Neuilly. It appears that since the death of her husband on a trip to Mauritius, Dominique Aubry has been ailing.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz
programme.sub-title: Only DNA Can Say - Angélique Dumetz
programme.desc: On February 23th 2017, policemen are alerted of the disapearrance of Brigitte Troadec, her husband Pascal, and their children Sébastien and Charlotte.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Jean-Raymond Blatti Case
programme.desc: Arriving at her work, the secretary of a small firm in the suburbs of Geneva finds the body of Jean-Raymond Blatti, the company's new accountant. The man is lying in a pool of blood and, on his belly, the murderer has written \"DIRTY RAPIST\".

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: A Very Strange Suicide (Muller case)
programme.desc: Police in Strasbourg receive a startling emergency call from Doctor Jean-Louis Muller, a forensic pathologist well known in the region.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Christophe Lejard Case
programme.desc: The lifeless body of Christophe Lejard is found by his son just metres from their home. The man was shot in the head as he was getting into his car to go to work. An execution, which at first glance doesn't square with the profile of a quiet family man.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)
programme.sub-title: Crime Scene Solvers: Deathly Fatal Passion At the Hotel (Villermet case)
programme.desc: The body of Nathalie Villermet, 46, manager of a small hotel and -restaurant, is found by a walker in the woods outside Paris, hidden under branches.

programme.title: Crime Scene Solvers: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
programme.sub-title: The Little Martyrship of A10: The Inass Touloub Affair
programme.desc: On August 11, 1987, the Orléans police discover the bruised corpse of a 4-year-old child behind a guardrail on the A10 motorway.

programme.desc: Darington skal kjøre det ultimate stunt-sporet, og alle Monstermaskiner i byen kommer for å se showet! Men når en sjalu Crusher sender Darington langt, langt avgårde, er det opp til Blaze og AJ å redde ham og få ham tilbake i tide til å gjøre stuntet

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinene!
programme.desc: Crusher og Pickle utfordrer Blaze og vennene til et seilbåt-race. Men når han prøver å jukse, krasjer Crusher uheldigvis begge båtene på en tropisk øy! Blaze og mannskapet hans må finne de manglende delene til båten før de kan seile hjem igjen.

programme.title: Dora utforskeren
programme.desc: Lille Kart har lært å tegne bilder av onkelen sin, Kart, og nå skal han være med Dora og Boots på skattejakt.

programme.title: Dora utforskeren
programme.desc: Underveis til et stort musikkshow faller Baby Bongo av lasteplanet på bilen, og de andre instrumentene fortsetter uten ham. Dora og Boots må hjelpe Baby Bongo så han kommer tidsnok til sitt aller første show.

programme.title: Boble Guppier
programme.desc: Hei alle sammen, se! Deema har en løs tann! Og når den faller ut kommer tannfeen og gir henne en premie! Men frem til det skjer, har tannlegen til Deema mange gode råd for hvordan vi beholder smilet vårt sunt!

programme.title: Boble Guppier
programme.desc: Kvelden for det store Badeballet er her og alle lurer på hvem som blir kronet Strandens Dronning! Blir det Molly´s nye venn Sandy? Guppiene hjelper Sandy på jobben for at hun skal rekke ballet i tide. Vil hun klare det tro?

programme.title: Boble Guppier
programme.desc: Mine damer og herrer, gutter og jenter; det utrolig populære Boble Brødre Sirkuset er i byen og Boble Guppiene blir med på forestillingen! Se klovnen Goby, akrobaten Gil, løvetemmer Oona og se opp for flygende paier!

programme.title: Stå På Diego!
programme.desc: Det er tid for karnevalsfeiring på fjelltoppen, og Lamaen Linda skal komme med msuikk og godteri til festen, men hun er ikke noe sted å se!

programme.title: Stå På Diego!
programme.desc: Armadillo vil være med i Regnskog-løpet, men har ikke noe lag. Diego blir med sammen med Armadillo og prøver å vinne løpet. De møter mange hindringer, komer de til å klare å vinne?

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine
programme.desc: Jentene møter en ånd som har krefter som kan endre hårfrisyrer, men Zeta er fast bestemt på å stjele kreftene. // Jentene reiser til en magisk hage, hvor de møter en flagre-ånd og krymper til hennes størrelse for å utforske.

programme.title: Shimmer og Shine
programme.desc: Samira tar med jente til en danselærer for å lære dem dansemagi. Men når Zeta tar lærerens magiske dansesko og bruke skoene til å ta over Zahramei by, må jentene bruke dansene de har lært til å stoppe henne.

programme.title: Dora og vennene
programme.desc: Kate, Dora og Pablo deler ut innsamlede leker til barn på barnesykehuset. Der treffer de den lille gutten Michael som er lei seg fordi tøy-apen hans Mono er blitt liggende igjen på toget.

programme.title: Dora og vennene
programme.desc: Et noteark forsvinner inn i Operaland, og Dora, Emma og Pablo må dra etter og finne igjen notene for å kunne avslutte et musikkstykke de har planlagt til bursdagen til Emmas bestemor.

programme.title: Dora utforskeren
programme.desc: Elevene på Doras skole har jobbet med prosjekter til en naturfagustilling for bruk av grønn energi.

programme.title: Dora utforskeren
programme.desc: Dora og Boots leker på stranda når de får høre noen som roper om hjelp. Det er den lille havfruen Maribel, og hun finner ikke tilbake til der hun bor.

programme.title: Stå På Diego!
programme.desc: Diego hjelper Baby Jaguar med å klatre opp til toppen av Jaguar-fjellet. For å klare det, må han klatre, strekke seg, og hoppe, hoppe, hoppe!

programme.title: Stå På Diego!
programme.sub-title: Chito and Rita the Spectacled Bears
programme.desc: Diego og Dora finner to små brillebjørner, Chito og Rita, som har gått seg bort i regnskogen.

programme.title: Blaze og Monstermaskinene!
programme.desc: Det er Lagtruck-utfordringsdagen, et løp der alle truckene skal konkurrere i lag på to! Men når Crusher velger en ny partner i stedet for Pickle, blir en skuffet Pickle med laget til Blaze for å bevise hvor tøff han er.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.sub-title: Penny Rescues the Aqua Wing / Bananas Away
programme.desc: Rocco og Chomps racer avgårde i Aquavingen til Penny. Hun må få den tilbake, ved å bruke ubåten til Chomp! // Når Sandy Stork leverer festeffekter til skolen, tar Bananbandittene flyet hennes. Kadettene må redde flyet og selskapet.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.sub-title: Junior Cadets Rescue / Sunken Treasure Race
programme.desc: Top Wing trener noen venner til å bli juniorkadetter. Når Baddy prøver å vise at han kan være en redningshelt, ender det med at Kadettene må redde ham. // Kadettene finner et skattekart. Når Baddy stjeler det, blir det et race for å finne Skatten.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Beverne lager en fantastisk vannpark på Virveløya-Plaskebad-dalen! Sydende vann setter mange i fare og truer med å ødelegge fjellet. Kadettene må under jorden for å redde Dodosene og fjellet.

programme.title: Top Wing
programme.desc: Baddy faller ut av jetflyet sitt mens Rod sitter på. Rod må holde seg i luften inntil Swift kan redde ham.

programme.title: Dora utforskeren
programme.desc: Dora og Boots skal til atelieret og fullføre et stort veggmaleri sammen med Daniela.

programme.title: Dora utforskeren
programme.desc: Kattungene til Dora hopper gjennom speilet og drar til Eventyrland, og da må bare Dora og Boots henge på for å få dem med tilbake igjen. De opplever mye spennende og møter mange rare skapninger på reisen.

programme.title: Brad's Status
programme.desc: Brad (Ben Stiller) lever et komfortabelt liv i et villastrøk i Sacramento sammen med sin godmodige kone (Jenna Fischer) og sønnen (Austin Abrams). Livet forandres da han blir gjenforent med sine gamle venner.

programme.title: Familien Beliér
programme.desc: Alle i Paulas familie er døve, bortsett fra henne. Dette gjør at familien er ekstra sterkt knyttet til sammen og alle stoler på hennes hjelp, både hjemme, på gården de bor på og på markedet der de selger varene de produserer. En dag kommer Gabriel…

programme.title: Ghost Town
programme.desc: En spirituell romantisk komedie, Ghost Town er historien om Bertram Pincus, en gretten tannlege på Manhattan som utvikler den uønskede evnen til å se døde folk.

programme.title: Wild Target
programme.desc: En iskald leiemorder får sitt liv snudd på hodet når han blir forelsket i sitt mål, en sjarmerende svindler med uventede planer.

programme.title: Anchorman: The Legend of Ron Burgundy
programme.desc: Ron Burgundy er et superpopulært nyhetsanker i 1970-årenes San Diego som mener at kvinner kan pynte opp et nyhetsrom. Så når Ron får vite han skal jobbe med en smart, vakker ung dame som mestrer mer enn å være til pynt, blir det krig!

programme.title: Jackass Number Two
programme.desc: Forbered deg på ukontrollerbare latterkramper og kvalmebølger når gutta kaster sine forslåtte kropper inn i en rekke absurde situasjoner.Jackass Number Two det er en komedie du vil se igjen og igjen.

programme.title: Mrs Henderson Presents
programme.desc: En eksentrisk enke åpner et teater med dristige revyforestillinger, som utfordrer moralen i et krigsherjet 1930-talls London.

programme.title: Wim Wenders Collection: Far Away So Close
programme.desc: En gruppe engler i den tyske hovedstaden ser med lengsel på menneskers liv.

programme.title: Le Mans
programme.desc: Steve McQueen er en amerikansk racersjåfør i 24-TIMERSLØPET PÅ LE MANS i denne heseblesende originalfilmen, som er filmet på Le Mans-banen, med bilstunt som gir deg hakeslepp og action som får hjertet til å banke.

programme.title: Fantomet
programme.desc: Historien begynner når en ekspedisjon går i land på øya Bengalla på leting etter Tougandas hodeskaller. Med sin evne til å styre energi kan de bli en katastrofe for menneskeheten.

programme.title: True Colors
programme.desc: Mens Tim drømte om å jobbe i justisdepartementet, ønsket Peter å bli en sterk politisk aktør - for enhver pris.

programme.title: Easy Come, Easy Go (1967)
programme.desc: On his last day in the Navy, frogman Elvis discovers a sunken treasure ship. On his first day as a civilian, Elvis starts his new job—self-employed treasure hunter!

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Nikkos wants a spectacular 1968 Mustang Fastback resto-mod. The all-metal masterpiece catches the eye of someone who wants it at any cost. Jim and Arlene want to enjoy their 45th anniversary in the same 1969 Firebird they rode in on their wedding day.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: This time, on Muscle Cars of Texas, Vinnie and the team are working on a 63 Z06, 59 Ford Pickup and a 69 Chevy Malibu.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: The owner of a C10 pick-up wants a full frame off restoration and as Dan predicted, things get ugly when they peel off the paint. A Heinkel came in with mismatched scooter parts hiding an incredibly rare car - which makes parts almost impossible to find.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.sub-title: 1963 Corvette, 1931 Ford Model A Hot Rod
programme.desc: Dan and the team take on the restorations of a 1963 corvette and a 1931 Model A hot rod. The corvette has to be ready in time for a wedding in less than two months. The hot rod has been torn to pieces by a well-intentioned internet mechanic.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Firepower Operation
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Mopar or No Car
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Charles wants Dan to find him a 1967 Corvette with a set-up that’s rare as hen’s teeth. Bob’s 1973 Cuda has been stored for most of its life – but even in storage time takes a heavy toll.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team are fresh off of winning some awards in Galveston, Texas. Moody Gardens Classic Car show is always a blast.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dave traded for his dream 1957 Corvette more than three decades ago, but his plans to build it have so far come to nothing. Ken chose a rare 1954 Kaiser Darrin from his father’s collection and its now on FantomWorks to reverse the hands of time.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Operation Firepower?
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: Firepower Un-Boxed
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Graveyard Carz: General Lee Considered
programme.desc: The world is littered with the remains of forgotten muscle cars. At Graveyard Carz, some will get a second chance in the hands of Mark Worman and the Ghouls.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas are tackling the electrical of the 1966 Blue Mustang. The 1969 Chevelle Malibu is in the paint shop.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tom asks Dan to find him a rare 1967 Camaro Convertible with factory AC. But when Dan finds the Unicorn, the car is too good to cut up. Dave wants Dan to build a safe, all stock 1971 Datsun, but the car has been badly damaged by previous restoration work.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Tom and Patti want to drive their 1967 Amphicar on land and water, but the hybrid boat-car has problems from stem to stern. Doc Pellerin hasn’t started his ultra-rare Austin 10/4 in years. He needs Dan to get it running for a major car show in four days.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Past Life Regression Pt. 2
programme.desc: Richard witnesses a municipal employee in Toronto, Canada undergo a regression during which he re-experiences a previous life as a doctor in early 20 century England.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Bible Codes
programme.desc: Does the Bible contain hidden messages encoded within certain passages of the Old Testament? Is the prophetic nature of these 'codes' proof the Bible's author is of supernatural or extraterrestrial origin?

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.sub-title: Journey to the Center of the Earth
programme.desc: Richard interviews the expedition organizer who is planning on leading a team of scientists, filmmakers and tourists to the Arctic aboard a Russian nuclear ice-breaker in search of an entrance into the interior of our world.

programme.title: The Conspiracy Show With Richard Syrett
programme.desc: Richard meets members of the 9/11 Truth movement who challenge the official version of events concerning the attack on the U.S. Pentagon. Researchers present evidence to suggest the attack was perpetrated by some rogue element inside the U.S. government.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Razor Ruddock's Home
programme.desc: We visit the home of Soccer legend Neil "Razor" Ruddock which seems to be haunted. Is it his home specifically? Or are these ghosts attached to him?

programme.title: Past Hunters: Blackpool Pleasure Beach
programme.desc: Blackpool Pleasure Beach is one of the most visited attractions in the United Kingdom. People visit it not only for the fun, but to also hopefully catch a glimpse of the many ghosts that haunt there.

programme.title: Past Hunters: Whitby Hall
programme.desc: Built in the early 1800s, Whitby Hall used to be an administrative center and now stands as a public park and arts center. It has never before been investigated, but staff have reported many noises and presences among them.

programme.title: My Haunted House: Pest House and Sleepwalkers
programme.desc: An earthquake triggers terrifying activity in a house with a dark past. A young woman sees visions in her sleep that lead her to an abandoned hospital.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Whispering and Ethel
programme.desc: After returning home for her mother's funeral, a young woman is terrorized by visions from her past. A musician finds a suicide note that reveals the dark history of his new house.

programme.title: My Haunted House: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
programme.sub-title: The Boy Did It and Frozen Forest
programme.desc: A five-year-old boy claims that his imaginary friend pushed his sister through a second story window. A newly divorced woman relives the terrifying history of the remote cabin she's rented.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: It Watches Me While I Sleep
programme.sub-title: It Watches Me While I Sleep
programme.desc: The suburban house of two young cousins is filled with scary encounters after a demonic ceramic giraffe is brought into their home.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: The Axe Murderer
programme.desc: An unknown axe murderer still stalks a family he brutally murdered a century ago and then next-door a spirit with a deadly secret haunts a young couple. An off the beaten path bar is stocked with other worldly spirits.

programme.title: My Ghost Story: An Entity in Bed
programme.desc: An entity jumps into a woman's bed and lies down beside her; two sisters' ghosts roam a Civil War-era house; a castle built on an old Indian burial ground is haunted by its original owner; and more.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Van Horn Mansion
programme.desc: Nick tries to contact a spirit to see if she'll reveal her cause of death.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: Risser Hospital
programme.desc: Nick investigates why the spirits of deceased patients of the Risser Hospital are becoming more aggressive.

programme.title: Death Walker with Nick Groff: The Tall Shadow Man
programme.desc: Nick calls upon the spirit of Tall Shadow Man to ask why he haunts those who enter the Iron Island Museum.

programme.title: Back To Love
programme.desc: For første gang siden Ericas ektemann døde, vender hun tilbake til hjembyen for å delta i søsterens bryllup. Der blir hun overrasket over de romantiske følelsene hun har for en gammel venn.

programme.title: Reaching for the Moon
programme.desc: En kronikk om det tragiske kjærlighetsforholdet mellom den amerikanske poeten Elizabeth Bishop og den brasilianske arkitekten Lota de Macedo Soares.

programme.title: 10 Things we should do before we break up
programme.desc: Den kvelden da Abigail, enslig mor til to små barn, møter Ben på en bar, lager de på fleip en liste over ting å gjøre før et tenkt brudd, enda de godt vet at de aldri kommer til å innlede noe forhold engang.

programme.title: A Kind of Magic
programme.desc: Hekserådet forventer at Matt skal gifte seg med heksen Lizzie, men han møter en annen – Sara. Da slutter hans magiske krefter å virke. Sara på sin side oppdager at hun har tatt imot dem.

programme.title: No Stranger Than Love
programme.desc: Hva er merkeligere enn det store hullet som åpner seg i Lucy Sherringtons stuegulv. Kjærligheten, virker det som.

programme.title: The Way Way Back
programme.desc: 14 år gamle Duncan sliter med å passe inn i sin nye familesituasjon, med mor, hennes nye, nedlatende kjæreste, og hans datter. Mens moren blir stadig mer fraværende finner Duncan en usannsynlig venn i sjefen på badeanlegget hvor han har sommerjobb.

programme.title: Youth in Revolt
programme.desc: Michael Cera (SUPERBAD) spiller Nick Twisp. En unik, men elskverdig tenåring med en smak for de sofistikerte tingene i livet. Han forelsker seg i den nydelige og intelligente Sheeni Saunders (Portia Doubleday) på campingferie med familien.

programme.title: Mutant X: A Normal Life
programme.desc: Mutant X sporer opp en useriøs forsker mens Shalimar bryter seg bort fra teamet for å hjelpe Adam med å redde forskeren - og avdekke den virkelige dårlige fyren.

programme.title: Mutant X: Divided Loyalties
programme.desc: Brennan blir tvunget til å gå tilbake til sin kriminelle fortid når Mutant X oppdager at hans gamle partner er involvert i å stjele hemmeligheter fra Dominion.

programme.title: Mutant X: Age of Innocence
programme.desc: Mutant X avdekker et gammelt militært eksperiment som involverer et aldersreverseringsserum og er overrasket over å oppdage at bestefaren til Jesse er en av testpersonene.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Fire in the Sky
programme.desc: Mens Sydney holder foredrag om indianerne som møtte en mystisk katastrofe 600 år tidligere, gir en innfødt henne en relikvie fra den tiden. Hva er hemmeligheten?

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Hunting with the Enemy
programme.desc: En urn bestilt i et kambodsjansk kloster av den kinesiske keiseren for restene av Confucius er i ferd med å bli ødelagt av den systematiske bombingen av en hel provins.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Under the Ice
programme.desc: Til tross for forferdelig vær, drar Sidney Nigel med til en arktisk base hvor en gammel indisk mamma er funnet, som viser seg å være en Anasazi.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Antianeirai
programme.desc: Sydney og Nigel reiser til Istanbul for å undersøke dødsfallet til en av Sydneys venner, en professor som prøvde å bevise at Hercules eksisterte ved å finne Hippolytebeltet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Himmelhvelvet
programme.desc: Dylan hører stemmer som tilsier ham til en planet med 'ild og is'.

programme.title: Andromeda: Deep Midnight's Voice
programme.desc: Mens han er fanget i en kamp mellom to Nietzschean-stolthetspunkter, fanger mannskapet en fiendtlig som hevder at stoltheten hans har et kart over slipstream.

programme.title: Andromeda: Illusjonen av majestet
programme.desc: En feil sving etter å ha gått ut av en slipstream sender Andromeda inn i Prolon-systemet. De redder en fluktpute fra en viss katastrofe, men stoltheten vil ha den tilbake.

programme.title: Andromeda: Twilight of the Idols
programme.desc: Mannskapet søker en tapt koloni av Nietzscheans og oppdager et annet mannskap som i det skjulte har hjulpet dem.

programme.title: Mutant X: She's Come Undone
programme.desc: Mutant X-teamet oppdager at lagkameraten deres Lexa er gjenstand for et skjult eksperiment som kontrollerer henne, og hunter etter ansvarlig lege.

programme.title: Mutant X: In Between
programme.desc: Når Jesses liv henger i sving, må Brennan koble seg til ham og lede ham gjennom minner de har delt for å redde livet hans.

programme.title: Mutant X: Dream Lover
programme.desc: Mutant X må stoppe en forsker fra å klone kvinner for bruk som slaver i sin ultra-eksklusive herreklubb.

programme.title: Relic Hunter: Faux Fox
programme.desc: Når Nigel blir sjarmert av den briljante studenten Lorraine å vise henne kontorene sine (og kyss), slår en innbruddstyv Sidney ut, men hva ble ranet?

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Thomas Dunkley
programme.desc: The case of carer Thomas Dunkley, who aided boxer Shaun 'The Guv'nor' Cummins after he became paralysed, and later killed and dismembered his patient.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Beverley James
programme.desc: The story of debt-ridden mother-of-three and night-time sex worker Beverley James. By day, she was meant to care for Harriet Davison, a frail woman she beat to death.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Thelma Purchase
programme.desc: Care worker Thelma Purchase plotted with her son and a friend to murder disabled Greg Baker who Purchase once worked for. She knew he couldn't defend himself and she stood to be a beneficiary in his will.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Chaz Higgs
programme.desc: The murder of American politician Kathy Augustine, who died after being given the paralysing drug succinylcholine by her husband Chaz Higgs, a professional nurse.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Bunthawee Rimmer
programme.desc: This edition looks at the case of care worker Bunthawee Rimmer, who beat Paul Norfolk to death in a hammer attack after he changed his will to leave her a sizeable legacy.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Marie Whiston
programme.desc: When an autopsy reveals high levels of insulin in Eric Lloyd's body, police realise that his widow, nurse Marie Whiston, had been using her medical skills not to care but to kill.

programme.title: Nurses Who Kill: Alison Firth
programme.desc: This edition examines the story of Alison Firth, a nurse who was unable to face the amount of work required caring for her 84-year-old charge and resorted to extreme lengths to avoid the work.

programme.title: Courage in Red: VIP Protection (The Francophonie Summit)
programme.desc: With 66 countries in attendance, the Summit Francophone hosted the largest deployment of foreign dignitaries in Canadian history. We're given special access to RCMP security measures at the Francophonie Summit where dangerous threats abound.

programme.title: Courage in Red: VIP Protection
programme.desc: A new group of students try to make the grade in the RCMP’s prestigious National VIP protection program.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Customs and Excise (Counter Smuggling)
programme.desc: Thanks to collaborative efforts with US and Canadian police; the RCMP is making a difference in stemming the flood of the illicit contraband that funds organized crime across the country.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Depot (Basic Police Recruit Training)
programme.desc: Depot is where it all starts; following raw recruits trying to prove they have what it takes to become a Mountie.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Remote Policing
programme.desc: RCMP members face extreme temperatures, landscapes, and working conditions policing in the far North.

programme.title: Courage in Red: ERT (Emergency Response Team)
programme.desc: The Emergency Response Team is a group of highly trained RCMP members capable of employing specialized weapons, equipment, and tactics to resolve extremely high-risk situations.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Peace Operations (UN Policing)
programme.desc: A new RCMP-trained contingent of Canadian police offers is deployed on a peace mission to the dangerous streets of Haiti.

programme.title: Courage in Red: West Coast Marine Service
programme.desc: There is no such thing as a typical day for the West Coast Marine Service - the force policing the coastline from Washington to Alaska. The RCMP’s West Coast Marine Service police the most remote areas of our country.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Frontline Policing
programme.desc: This is the “meat and potatoes” of policing. Follow members of the RCMP as they police Canada’s frontlines.

programme.title: Courage in Red: S.A.F.E. (School Shootings)
programme.desc: The RCMP and its partners work together to defend our schools from suicidal gunmen as we observe the specialised training of the S.A.F.E. plan.

programme.title: Courage in Red: K9 (Police Dog Services)
programme.desc: RCMP K9, exploring the special bond between handler and dog as they police the frontlines of Canada.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Clan Labs
programme.desc: Behind the closed-doors of the RCMP drug units which target the dangerous Meth and Ecstasy labs devastating Canadian neighbourhoods.

programme.title: Courage in Red: Youth Programs
programme.desc: Police officers are in a unique position to play an important role in the lives of youth. Members of the RCMP devote themselves to making a positive difference in the lives of young Canadians.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Seizing Power
programme.desc: In 1930s Germany, Hitler capitalizes on economic woes blaming the Weimar Government and Jews. Despite scandals, Nazi rallies gain popularity and emerge as the largest party. Hitler becomes Chancellor in 1933, using the 'Enabling Act' to seize power.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Slovenia: The Crow's Flight
programme.desc: Monty heads to Slovenia to retrace one of the most daring, yet unknown, mass escapes of Allied prisoners during the second world war, made possible only with the help of partisans and locals.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Vidkun Quisling
programme.desc: Vidkun Quisling, once honored for diplomacy, turned traitor by collaborating with Nazis. His bid for power in Norway failed, relegated by Germans. Despite being named "fuehrer," his reign led to repression until his hanging post-Nazi defeat.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: The Gatling Gun, designed to change 19th-century battlefields, now reigns supreme in the skies as a high-speed offensive weapon. With a 150-year legacy of havoc it continues to be a formidable force.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Nazis Outfought
programme.desc: By 1944, Hitler's image as a victorious leader is crumbling. He faces a bomb plot led by Stauffenberg and Tresckow, intending to kill him and overthrow the regime. Hitler survives the bombing, triggering a brutal reprisal against conspirators.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Dutch Collaborator
programme.desc: Anton Adriaan Mussert, initially resisted Hitler’s anti-Semitism despite modeling his NSB party, even welcoming Jewish members. His failed attempt to kidnap Queen Wilhelmina led him into hiding, after which he collaborated in hopes of gaining power.

programme.title: Secret War: The SAS Italian Job
programme.desc: In 1945, during the Italian Spring offensive, SOE agent Michael Lees and SAS officer Roy Farran led a raid on German HQs at Villa Rossi and Villa Calvi. Despite orders to cancel, Farran attacked with SAS men and partisans, killing many Germans.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Special Forces operate deep behind enemy lines with top-of-the-line weapons.Host Wil Willis tests the Sig Sauer P226, the preferred choice like the Mark 25 by Navy SEALs, against competitors like the H&K Compact Tactical.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Croatian Collaborator
programme.desc: Croatia grapples with its fascist past through figures like Dinko Sakic, once hailed as a hero but later convicted of war crimes. Leading the notorious Jasenovac camp, Sakic oversaw brutal atrocities against inmates.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
